features: Charging Case: Convenient charging case ensures your SmartRing is always powered up and ready to go.
Lightweight Stainless-Steel Design: Sleek and durable stainless-steel construction offers both style and resilience.
Multiple Sports Mode and Fitness Challenges: Take your fitness journey to the next level with various sports modes and engaging challenges.
Camera Control: Seamlessly control your smartphone camera directly from your SmartRing Active.
Heart Rate and Blood Oxygen Monitoring: Stay informed about your heart health and oxygen levels in real-time.
Sleep and Stress Monitoring: Monitor your sleep patterns and stress levels to optimize your overall well-being.
boAt Coins Integration: Earn and redeem boAt Coins for exclusive rewards and benefits.
5 ATM Dust, Water, and Splash Resistant: With a 5 ATM rating, the SmartRing Active can withstand dust, water, and splashes, making it suitable for various environments and activities.
